description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 02.11.2015 to 08.11.2015
categorisation: This gazette notification is a Customs Notification issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) that sets new official exchange rates for calculating customs duties and other charges. It rescinds a previous notification and establishes a new legal/regulatory framework for currency conversion in customs transactions, making it a clear example of a Legal/Regulatory Gazette.
